---
description: "Use when extracting reusable learnings from completed work, failed attempts, reviews, or repeated issues."
---

# Learning Loop

- Use the ladder: `review note -> learning -> invariant`.
- A review note is local and provisional.
- A learning is reusable and medium-confidence.
- An invariant is compressed, high-confidence, and repeatedly useful.
- Store fresh findings structurally, not narratively.
- Promote only after reuse, verification, or review.
- Shared memory is canonical for team-wide truth.
- Session-style memory is temporary and must not become the only source of durable knowledge.
